The '''Mothma family''' was an important political family of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republics]]. Members included:

*[[Mon Mothma's father/Legends|An unidentified man]], an [[Arbiter-general/Legends|arbiter-general]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]];
*[[Tanis Mothma]], his wife, [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]
**[[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], their daughter, [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of [[Bormea sector/Legends|Bormea sector]] and [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]
***[[Lieda Mothma]], her daughter
***[[Jobin]], her son, soldier in the early Rebellion, perished in the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]
*[[Kell Bircher]], Mon Mothma's nephew

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Kevin Rubio]]'s parody comic-strip, ''[[The Return of Tag & Bink: Special Edition]]'', Mon Mothma is implied to be romantically involved with a man named [[Manuel Both-Hanz|Manny Both-Hanz]].
